title: Phlebotomy Overview — Quick Reference Guide
description: A concise one-page summary of the phlebotomy role, key responsibilities, and scope of practice in UK healthcare settings.

title: Blood Collection Equipment Checklist
description: Printable checklist of all equipment needed before, during, and after a blood draw. Ideal for trainees to review before their first supervised procedure.

title: Vacutainer Tube Colour Coding Chart
description: Full-colour reference card mapping tube colours to additives, test types, and required volumes. Keep this at your workstation.

title: WHO Guidelines on Phlebotomy Practices
description: The World Health Organization's official best-practice guidelines for phlebotomy in healthcare settings — an essential reference document.

title: 12-Lead ECG Systematic Reading Worksheet
description: A structured worksheet to practise reading ECG traces using the methodical approach taught in this lesson. Includes 5 practice traces with an answer key.
